title: Delegent: A Multi-Agent Harness That Reduces Cost without Sacrificing Performance
abstract: arXiv:2611.33098v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents built on frontier language models are expensive. At every step, the frontier model re-reads its entire context and executes every subtask regardless of its difficulty. This paper explores the simple thesis that much of this cost can be removed by delegating easy subtasks to a small language model, or SLM, that runs on hardware one already owns. To test it, we build Delegent, a simple and effective agent harness built on Claude Code, in which the frontier model stays in charge of every task but hands focused subtasks, such as investigating code, running tests, and searching a corpus, to SLM subagents. Existing approaches such as cascades and model routers usually choose which model executes the entire task, whereas in Delegent, the frontier model always leads the execution and delegates easy subtasks to the SLM. translated_title: Delegent：一个在不牺牲性能的前提下降低成本的多智能体框架
translated_abstract: 基于前沿语言模型构建的智能体成本高昂。在每一步中，前沿模型都会重新读取其全部上下文并执行每一个子任务，而不考虑任务本身的难度。本文探讨了一个简单的论点：通过将简单的子任务委托给可以在用户自有硬件上运行的小型语言模型（SLM），可以大幅削减这部分成本。为了验证这一论点，我们构建了Delegent，这是一个基于Claude Code构建的简单而有效的智能体框架。在该框架中，前沿模型始终主导整个任务，但会将聚焦的子任务（如调查代码、运行测试和搜索语料库）交给SLM子智能体处理。现有方法（如级联和模型路由器）通常选择由哪个模型执行整个任务，而在Delegent中，前沿模型始终主导执行过程，仅将简单的子任务委托给SLM。无需训练任何路由器或模型，因此两个模型都可以自由替换。借助一个27B FP8的SLM，Delegent降低了……
tldr: Delegent是一个基于Claude Code的多智能体框架，让前沿模型始终主导任务执行、仅将简单子任务委托给可在本地硬件运行的27B小型语言模型，从而无需训练路由器即可在不牺牲性能的情况下大幅降低智能体运行成本。
en_tdlr: Delegent is a multi-agent harness built on Claude Code where the frontier model always leads execution and delegates easy subtasks to a small 27B language model running on local hardware, reducing cost without sacrificing performance and requiring no router or model training.
